title: 一番はじめは一の宮 (Ichiban Hajime — Shrine Counting Song)
description: A traditional counting song (数え歌) that recites numbers 1–10 by pairing each number with a famous shrine or temple across Japan: 一の宮 (Ichinomiya), 日光東照宮 (Nikko Toshogu), 佐倉の惣五郎 (Sakura's Sogoro), 善光寺 (Zenkoji), 出雲大社 (Izumo Grand Shrine), 鎮守様 (local guardian shrines), 成田の不動様 (Narita Fudo), 大和の大仏様 (Nara's Great Buddha), 高野の弘法様 (Kobo Daishi at Koyasan), and 東京招魂社 (now Yasukuni Shrine). Children memorize sacred geography while practicing counting. Anonymous traditional folk song documented in the Meiji era.
